signature: SUBROUTINE ZSPRFS( UPLO, N, NRHS, AP, AFP, IPIV, B, LDB, X, LDX,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrices B and X. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangle of the symmetric matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: AFP
params.reference: The factored form of the matrix A. `AFP` contains the block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L from the factorization $A = U \, D \, U^T$ or $A = L \, D \, L^T$ as computed by ZSPTRF, stored as a packed triangular matrix.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZSPTRF.

params.name: B
params.reference: The right hand side matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the solution matrix X, as computed by ZSPTRS. On exit, the improved solution matrix X.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: FERR
params.reference: The estimated forward error bound for each solution vector `X(j)` (the j-th column of the solution matrix X). If XTRUE is the true solution corresponding to `X(j)`, `FERR(j)` is an estimated upper bound for the magnitude of the largest element in (`X(j)` - XTRUE) divided by the magnitude of the largest element in `X(j)`. The estimate is as reliable as the estimate for RCOND, and is almost always a slight overestimate of the true error.

params.name: BERR
params.reference: The componentwise relative backward error of each solution vector `X(j)` (i.e., the smallest relative change in any element of A or B that makes `X(j)` an exact solution).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
